AliasUse.description: A suffix alias in use for one file (spec §3.7, DECISIONS Note G).

parallax.description:
`complex_material` only (DECISIONS AH2): `false` writes alpha 0 at every mip (complex material on, parallax
off); `true` keeps the source alpha as height. Resolve sets it from the source alpha; `None` elsewhere.

threshold.description: 8-bit alpha-test threshold, per texture; allowed 1..=254 (checked in policy).

AlphaStats.description: Counts of decoded alpha values over one image.

BakeJob.description: How a roughness member bakes its set's `_n` (`ResolvedJob::bake`, spec §6.2). Set by `plan::plan_bakes`.

normal_profile.description:
That `_n`'s resolved profile: the member decodes the `_n` with it exactly as the `_n`'s own job does
(swizzle, green flip, Z rebuild; DECISIONS R4).

rnm.description:
The `_n` job's active RNM blend at plan time (Note W18, owner 2026-10-12): the lengths come from the `_n` as its
own encode writes it, after the layers.

shift.description: log2(`_n` size / member size) ([`bake_shift`]) as planned.

stamp.description: The `_n`'s size and modification time when `Engine::plan` read it (final review I7); `None` is not checked.

BentSpec.description: The `bent` layer: a layer plus its AO-blend settings (F2 spec §3.1, §3.3).

ao.description: Read the AO source; `false` = a uniform weight.

ao_power.description: The power on the occlusion `1 − AO`; `None` = 1.5.

ChannelSource.description: What a packed channel holds; serialised in `file_planned` (`job.pack.channels`) and the manifest.

oneOf.description:
R (or luma) of a raw source; `invert` stores 1 − x. `channel` (0..=2) reads that channel of an `_orm`
instead (DECISIONS Note AL); absent otherwise, so no other job's JSON changes.
A user fill (`packing.fill.<role>`); `code` is the 8-bit value written (255 − fill when inverted).
The neutral default of spec §6.4, 0..=1.
A copy of R.

green_convention.description:
Green (Y) convention of a normal source (spec §3.2, §4.4, DECISIONS Note H); None = unstated.
`opengl` makes Resolve set `flip_green`.

swizzle.description: Four characters from r, g, b, a, 0, 1 (e.g. "bgra", "rrr1"); None = identity.

FillSpec.description:
Global fill values for packed channels without a source map (spec §6.4, DECISIONS Notes H and M5): an 8-bit
code per §4.4 raw-map role, `None` = the neutral default. Unset fills are not serialised.

JobStatus.description:
What happens to a file (spec §5.2, §10). Serialises as `{"state": "ready"}`,
`{"state": "blocked", "codes": [...]}` and so on.

oneOf.description: A sub-type or alpha meaning still needs a decision (rule, flag or accepted high-confidence suggestion).

needs.description: What each reason is waiting for, so a GUI can offer the right control.

oneOf.description:
A raw single-channel map (spec §4.4): a channel-packing input (§6.4), not converted on its own and not an
error; a raw map waiting for `pack::plan::plan_packing`, which consumes it into a recipe or re-tags it
`PACK-UNUSED-INPUT`.

An RNM normal layer or mask (M6 Track F2 spec §2.2): never converted on its own; `rnm::plan::plan_rnm`
attaches it to its base normal's job or tags it `RNM-*`.
Blocking codes not acknowledged with `--allow`.

LayerId.description: One RNM normal layer (M6 Track F2 spec §2.1).

LayerSpec.description:
One layer's settings (F2 spec §4). Every field is optional at its default: `strength` = the layer's
`default_strength`, `flip_green` = the base's own `channels.flip_green`, `mask` = on when the mask file exists.

LayerTermId.description: The serialisable mirror of [`LayerTerm`], carried by `JobStatus::NormalLayer`.

bake_clamp.description:
Clamp `t` of the variance bake (spec §6.2, DECISIONS Note E): the added variance is at most `t²`. 0.25;
allowed (0, 1]. Read from the profile the bake writes into: a roughness member, or a `_cnr`.

coverage.description:
Coverage preservation (spec §5.5). It only ever applies to the alpha-tested policies `cutout` and
`cutout_blend`: `auto` and `on` both enable it there, `off` disables it, and on any other policy (`blend`,
`data`, `remove`) every mode is a no-op, because blended alpha must keep box-averaged opacity.

edge.description: Edge handling of the mip filter taps: read only by tent, Mitchell and Kaiser (spec §3.2).

normal_base.description:
Mip 0 of a normal map (spec §5.4, DECISIONS R1): `renormalize` (default) stores every base vector at unit
length; `keep` stores the source as authored. Read only for the Normal category.

Need.description: What an unresolved job is waiting for (DECISIONS N9), so a GUI can offer the right control.

oneOf.description: The sub-type is a suggestion nobody confirmed.
The alpha meaning (policy) depends on the mesh and nobody chose it.
A plain `_normal`/`_nrm` source with no stated green convention.

PackJob.description: How a packed output is built (`ResolvedJob::pack`). `sources[0].path` is the job's `input` (Note M8).

gray.description:
The `channels.grayscale_source` this recipe was planned with (provenance, analysis and report all use it).
The pipeline assembles with this value, not with the final profile's, so the written image is the one that
was analysed (DECISIONS Note M6). Serialised, so it shows in `file_planned` and the manifest.

PackRecipe.description:
Which cs recipe a set packs (DECISIONS Note R-fills-1): `auto` = `_rfaos` when a fuzz source exists, else
`_rmaos`; `rfaos`/`rmaos` force one.

PackSource.description: One source of a packed job and its size and modification time when planning read it (final review I7).

PackingSpec.description: Channel-packing settings (spec §3.2, §6.4). Fields of the packed output's profile, resolved like any other.

enabled.description: Pack this output's recipe; `false` leaves its raw maps as packing inputs (`IN-PACKING-INPUT`).

prefer.description: Which side wins when the set already holds the packed output as a file (`PACK-CONFLICT`).

recipe.description:
Which cs recipe this set packs (`auto`, `rmaos`, `rfaos`; DECISIONS Note R-fills-1). Set per set at either packed key,
`[files."<folder/base>_rfaos"]` or `..._rmaos"]`.

roughness_default.description: Neutral roughness (0..=1) for a channel without a roughness or glossiness source.

resize.description: Preprocess step 6 (spec §5.4); `pot-down` = largest power of two ≤ each axis, `half` = both axes halved when the larger is above 512 (M6 Track D).

rnm.description: RNM normal layers (M6 Track F2); read only by base normals (`Subtype::rnm_base`).

Provenance.description:
Where a resolved field value came from (spec §5.2). Declaration order is precedence order, lowest first.

Serialises as a string: `builtin`, `preset:<id>`, `rule:<source>#<n>` (the `Rule` payload is the
`<source>#<n>` part), `analysis:<fact>`, `shader:<id>`, `mesh:alpha`, `suffix:<term>`, `source:<file>`,
`default:<value>`, `fill:<code>`, `recipe:<kind>`, and the snake_case variant name for the rest.

oneOf.description: `cs` `<base>_rmaos.dds`: roughness, metallic, AO, specular.
`cs` `<base>_rfaos.dds`: roughness, fuzz, AO, specular.
`cs` `<base>_p.dds`: height (BC4).
`cpm` complex `<base>_m.dds`: env mask, glossiness, metallic, height.
`vanilla` env-mask `<base>_m.dds` (BC4).

channels.description: Provenance of R, G, B and A (`source:…`, `default:…`, `fill:…`); empty for a mirrored or opaque channel.

RecipeStatus.description: What became of one channel-packing recipe of a set (spec §6.4 "Reporting").

oneOf.description: Planned as a job.
The set already holds this output as a file (`PACK-CONFLICT`); `reason` says which side is used.
A source could not be read or the sources differ in size.
`packing.enabled = false`: the raw maps stay packing inputs.

bake.description:
A roughness member's normal-variance bake (spec §6.2, DECISIONS R4): the `_n` it reads and how. `None` for
every other job and for a member that does not bake.

pack.description:
How a packed output is built from its raw sources (spec §6.4); `None` for an ordinary file. For a packed
job `input` is `pack.sources[0].path` (DECISIONS Note M8).

provenance.description: Dotted field path → where its value came from; includes `subtype`, `category` and `target`.

rnm.description: M6 Track F2: a base normal's RNM layers (`rnm::plan::plan_rnm`); `None` for every other job.

shader.description: M6 (DECISIONS Note S): the shader picked for this job's set; `None` for a job not made by `plan`.

source.description:
The source's size and modification time when `Engine::plan` read it (final review I7). `run` converts the
file only while they still match; `None` (a job not made by `plan`) is not checked.

suffix_alias.description: The suffix alias this file matched (spec §3.7); its preset chain resolved the profile.

channel.description: 0 = a raw AO map's R, 2 = `_rmaos`/`_rfaos` B.

RnmFile.description: One input file of a blend, with the stamp `plan` read it at (checked by `run`, like `ResolvedJob::source`).

RnmSpec.description:
RNM normal layers (M6 Track F2 spec §4). A field of every profile, read only by base normals (`Subtype::rnm_base`);
not serialised at its default, so profile hashes written before F2 hold (DECISIONS Note W6).

RnmTarget.description: Which base normal a layer file feeds (F2 spec §2.3): `n` (`_n`), `cnr` (`_cnr`) or both.

Shader.description: A Skyrim shader a texture set is made for (spec §3).

ShaderOrigin.description: Why a set has its shader (spec §4.4). Serialises as a string: `set`, `auto:<rule id>`, `fallback`.

ShaderPick.description: A set's shader, why it was chosen, and the shader asked for when that one was not available (`wanted`).

SkipKind.description: Why a file produced no output in this batch (DECISIONS N5).

oneOf.description: `--on-existing skip` kept an existing output.
A sub-type, alpha meaning or green convention still needs a decision.
A blocking code was not acknowledged.
`IN-DUPLICATE`: two inputs map to one output.
`IN-DDS-SKIPPED`.
A raw map not packed (`IN-PACKING-INPUT`, `PACK-UNUSED-INPUT`).
An RNM normal layer or mask (M6 Track F2): blended into its base normal, never written alone.
`OUT-UNKNOWN-EXISTING`.
`PACK-CONFLICT`: a pre-packed file replaced under `packing.prefer = raw`.
A raw map consumed by a recipe; the event's `job_key` names the packed output.

SourceStamp.description: A source file's size and modification time, to tell whether it changed between planning and conversion.

Subtype.description: A texture sub-type. `rfaos` is a deprecated alias of `skin_rfaos`: it still loads and is written back as `skin_rfaos`.

mips.description:
M6 Track D (DECISIONS Notes T5, Y6): `smallest` runs the per-mip PSNR check on the smallest mip only and the
coverage check on every level (`fast-preview`). Not serialised at its default, so existing profile hashes hold.

alpha.description: Decoded-alpha statistics per level, for formats that carry alpha (BC1, BC3, BC7).

coverage.description: Decoded coverage per level; filled only when the coverage check ran.

recipes.description: The set's channel-packing recipes (spec §6.4); absent when it packs nothing.

shader.description: M6 (DECISIONS Note S): the set's shader and why it was chosen.

warnings.description: SHADER-AUTO / SHADER-UNAVAILABLE, then SHADER-EXTRA-MAP / SHADER-MISSING-MAP for the set.

skip.description: Serialised as `skip`: `kind` is the event tag.

skipped.description: Every `file_skipped` that is not up to date and not a packing input.

skipped_intentional.description:
Of `skipped`, those skipped on purpose (`IN-DDS-SKIPPED`, `PACK-CONFLICT`, `--on-existing skip`); they
do not make the batch exit 1 (DECISIONS Notes I and M9). Absent in older streams.

job_key.description:
The job this event belongs to: its output path relative to the output root (DECISIONS N6). Absent on
batch-level events. Serialised as `job_key`: `file_planned` already carries its `job` object.
